profile.headline: Software Engineer at PrayFlock
profile.summary:
At PrayFlock, I’m helping a three-person startup build a community where people can pray for one another and support each other through topics, groups and individual prayers. I work directly with the founders to turn community needs into product priorities and own features from architecture and interface design through implementation, testing, and release.

My most recent release was Groups, a host-managed social experience for up to 50 members to share prayer topics, pray for their group, and interact through reactions. The tech stack is React Native, Expo, and Convex, and uses PostHog alongside user feedback to understand engagement and guide product improvements.

As of September 19, the app has 590 users, 179 weekly active users, 870 friendships, and 1.7K prayers. Working on a small team gives me the opportunity to combine engineering with product decisions and take responsibility for how a feature works, feels, and serves the people using it.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Flock - Pray with Friends. Building a prayer community. 1.5k+ prayers, 550+ total users, 160 WAU, and counting... 

Currently owning development for the Groups feature that will enable users to create communities within the app funneling group specific activity into its own feed to increase engagement and visibility of group related activities.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
- Spent the last 3 years shipping industry leading features every quarter to expand product verticals and improve customer experience
- Addressed the inefficiency of manually updating time slots by developing the Bulk Time Slot Editor enabling operators to modify thousands of time slots at once, resulting in a 100%+ increase in operator productivity and streamlining workflows. Technologies used: Ember.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, a custom-built component library, and the Ember add-on Vertical Collection for lazy loading large datasets.
- Rebuilt the legacy Reschedule feature from the ground up to improve customer rescheduling flow and support dynamic pricing, increasing operator revenue by 30%. Technologies used: Ember.js, TypeScript, GraphQL and Lit Web Components.
- Built and maintained a design system of headless components that sped up frontend development by 100%.
- Led frontend projects from planning through development, partnering with design and product managers to ship.
- Leveraged Augment Code AI tooling to decrease development time and complete tasks efficiently
positions.insights: Skills: CSS3 · GraphQL · Ember.js · Front-End Development · JavaScript · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained test data and business logic to support version upgrades and client-
specific workflows.
- Built BI reports that helped clients better understand key workflows and strategic planning.
- Configured servers and web apps to support deployed solutions across client environments.
- Built internal and demo apps using JavaScript, Bootstrap, and vanilla JS, integrating with APIs from
SAP, Teamcenter, and Oracle EBS.

positions.title: Implementation Manager
positions.description:
•	Project managed, through Salesforce, the development of websites for 107 accounts with an average CSAT of 4.5/5 totaling $838,000 in ARR. 
•	Strategized with the product management team and developed personas for the sales and customer success department to improve UX of internal company platform tools. 
•	Led client calls involving both SEO and design team members to find the best strategy for implementing market best practices.
•	Used Google Analytics and performed market research to find the most effective keywords for SEO best practices for each client.

positions.title: Implementation Consultant
positions.description:
•	Implemented the post-sales timeline by leading the onboarding process with clients and coordinating multiple internal teams including SEO, design, and account management. 
•	Proven project management ability where 100% of projects were completed within the designated deadlines. 
•	Strategized with head marketing contacts on how to best utilize websites for lead generation and marketing capabilities. 
•	Strengthened client relationships by leading all internal and external kick off calls and during website build by fully understanding their business and marketing needs. 
•	Collected all client feedback and communicated them internally to implement all necessary revisions and adjustments.

positions.title: Marketing Analyst
positions.description:
•	Organized focus groups and in-person surveys as part of a market research analysis and presented the findings to the CEO to inform his decision on creating an online presence for the non-profit organization. 
•	Strategized and executed social and e-mail marketing campaigns for non-profit events and developed strategic marketing content timelines to increase awareness and number of donors.

positions.title: Communications Manager
positions.description: EcoCAR 3 is an Advanced Vehicle Technology competition that empowers students from all disciplines to come together and represent their school in a race to build the best hybrid vehicle. My position within the team was the Communications manager. I lead a team focused on building the UW EcoCAR brand. We focused on youth outreach, target marketing, and social media development. This included developing a communications plan for important deliverables.

projects.title: Made Your Look
projects.description:
https://github.com/sgk94/madeyourlook

madeyourlook is an AI-powered personal shopping assistant that curates outfits based on your style, budget, and preferences.

Users complete a short, interactive style quiz — then madeyourlook continuously scans the web for new product drops, price changes, and full outfit recommendations tailored to them. Think of it as your AI stylist, built for the real world.
